title: Potential infinite loop
detail: The `_reset` method is called without a condition, which could lead to an infinite loop if the parser is not properly reset.
note: _reset is called once per exchange; there is no loop.

title: Inverted condition
detail: The condition checks if `cmd_name` is 'less' when `color` is `None`, but it should check if `color` is `None` when `cmd_name` is 'less'.
note: Restates the same condition in other words.

title: Potential subprocess call without timeout
detail: The subprocess call does not have a timeout, which could lead to hanging if the pager command takes too long.
note: A pager is interactive; a timeout would cut the user off.
